{{Quote|There's less buzz to your voice these days. Is that a new implant?''"<br />"''Upgraded, yes. The dean of the School of Mathematics insisted. Less buzz means less menacing, or something.|Face Loran and Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''School of Mathematics ''' was an academic division of [[Ayceezee Public College]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]].<ref name="MK" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> it employed [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Voort saBinring]] and was headed by a [[Unidentified School of Mathematics dean|dean]], who insisted that saBinring upgrade his vocal implant  to make his voice sound less menacing to students.<ref name="MK" />
